Description of the Biological Activity’s: Presence of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, exogenous amino acids, unsaturated fatty acids, phytosterols, bioelements, phospholipids, and vitamins.
Complexing metals; hydroxyl radicals are eliminated.
Inhibition of blood platelets aggregation and ACE activity are inhibited.
The activity of detoxifying in industrial poisoning; lipofuscin reduction.
Inhibitory activity of NO production and COX-2.

Bacteria metabolism is affected in the case of Pseudomonas aeruginosa (P. aeruginosa), Staphylococcus epidermis (S. epidermis), B. cerus, E. coli, S. aureus, Listeria monocytogenes (L. monocytogenes), B. subtilis, and Salmonella enterica

Brassica camperstris L. bee pollen extract is responsible for decreasing the expression of antiapoptotic proteins and for caspase-3 enzyme activity increase; 17β-estradiol activity is inhibited by Salix alba L. and Cistus incanus L. bee pollens.
Hemoglobin level is increasing while blood platelets number is decreasing.
Cystus ladaniferus L. bee pollen is responsible for increasing alkaline phosphatase level, resorption inhibition of the femur, and osteoclastic cell formation.
